xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-shp:DisclosureOfNotesOnShareholdi: Details with respect to Locked in Shares: The Management Committee of the Company, at its meetings held on 27th May, 2026 and 25th June, 2026, respectively, considered and approved the allotment of 1,00,000 equity shares of Rs.10 each pursuant to the exercise of the option to convert warrants into equity shares by Mr. Prakash Kacholia, Promoter of the Company. Pursuant to Regulation 167 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018 ("SEBI ICDR Regulations"), the aforesaid equity shares will be locked-in for a period of eighteen (18) months from the date of receipt of the trading approval from the Stock Exchange(s).
